workflow.initial_input: A security incident raised flags due to suspicious WMI process creation observed on a machine, which is indicative of possible malware activity. This was connected to a chain of processes including `get-userprttoken.ps1` and `curl` attempts. WMI is often utilized by malware to spawn new processes, breaking process trees and further infecting a machine. In relation to the attempt to access Primary Refresh Token (PRT), can you identify the name of the process involved in this activity?
